marble.agate.description: Veins of color that are never the same from one marble to the next. It gets along with everyone.
marble.agate.name: agate
marble.bee.description: Striped yellow and black, it almost buzzes as it rolls. Where there's one, there's a hundred.
marble.bee.name: bee
marble.bloodstone.description: Dark green flecked with red, as if someone bled on it centuries ago. It is never won, only earned.
marble.bloodstone.name: bloodstone
marble.bubble.description: So thin and clear you'd think it was about to pop. It always comes back, as if nothing happened.
marble.bubble.name: bubble
marble.cats_eye.description: Clear glass pierced by a colored flame, like a pupil. They say it can see in the dark.
marble.cats_eye.name: cat's eye
marble.clay.description: The fired-clay marble of every playground, a little rough under the thumb. It looks like nothing much, which is exactly why you can count on it.
marble.clay.name: clay
marble.comet.description: A glacier-blue peewee trailing a milky streak behind it. It never arrives alone.
marble.comet.name: comet
marble.copper.description: A coppery marble turning slightly green at the edges. Old-timers swear it brings luck to whoever rubs it long enough.
marble.copper.name: copper
marble.dolphin.description: Smooth blue-grey with a white wave along its side. It leaps more than it rolls, and loves to jostle the others.
marble.dolphin.name: dolphin
marble.dragon.description: Emerald scales and an amber eye that seems to follow you. Grown-ups ban it from the playground, which of course makes it irresistible.
marble.dragon.name: dragon
marble.eclipse.description: Ink-black, ringed by a thin halo of light. When it passes, the whole playground holds its breath.
marble.eclipse.name: eclipse
marble.fireball.description: Orange and red, with little flames frozen in the glass. It's always slightly warm, even in winter.
marble.fireball.name: fireball
marble.galaxy.description: A spiral of purple and golden dust turns slowly at its heart. Some kids claim to have spotted planets inside.
marble.galaxy.name: galaxy
marble.ghost.description: Pure white, more or less see-through depending on its mood. You lose it, you look for it, and it's already back in your pocket.
marble.ghost.name: ghost
marble.grenade.description: Khaki green, crosshatched with ridges, with an odd little stem on top. Best not to be nearby when it goes.
marble.grenade.name: grenade
marble.ingot.description: A small gold ingot polished until it turned round. It weighs in the hand like a promise.
marble.ingot.name: ingot
marble.moon.description: Grey and dotted with tiny craters. On full-moon nights, it rolls a little farther than the others.
marble.moon.name: moon
marble.ocean.description: Blues and greens that ripple without ever quite mixing. Held to your ear, you'd swear you can hear the surf.
marble.ocean.name: ocean
marble.pearl.description: Pearly, soft as a cheek, with a faint smell of salt. Divers say it calls out to its lost sisters.
marble.pearl.name: pearl
marble.quicksilver.description: A droplet of silver that never sits still, even at the bottom of a pocket. They say it always finds its way to the treasure chest.
marble.quicksilver.name: quicksilver
marble.red_devil.description: Bright red slashed with a yellow band, like a crooked grin. It always wins, but nobody likes what it costs.
marble.red_devil.name: red devil
marble.ruby.description: A red so deep you'd swear a heart beats inside. The longer you keep it, the brighter it shines.
marble.ruby.name: ruby
marble.sling_shot.description: Small, hard, and made to fly. It fears nothing, least of all marbles bigger than itself.
marble.sling_shot.name: sling shot
marble.snow_globe.description: Tiny snowflakes swirl inside whenever it's shaken. No one has ever figured out how they got in.
marble.snow_globe.name: snow globe
marble.soda.description: Cola-colored, you'd swear it still fizzes when shaken. It can't sit still, and it never lasts long.
marble.soda.name: soda
marble.spider.description: Black with silver threads that look like a web. Whatever gets too close has trouble leaving.
marble.spider.name: spider
marble.star.description: Perfectly clear, with a single glittering spark suspended at its center. Rumor says it fell from an August sky.
marble.star.name: star
marble.steel.description: A ball bearing escaped from an old bicycle, cold and heavy. Nobody knocks it out; it does the knocking.
marble.steel.name: steel
marble.tornado.description: A grey and white spiral that makes you dizzy just looking at it. After it passes, little is left standing.
marble.tornado.name: tornado
marble.turtle.description: A green and brown shell etched with hexagons. It has outlasted generations of players and plans to see many more.
marble.turtle.name: turtle

marbles.goal.title: Goal and rules
marbles.help.goal.text: Place marbles on the triangle to fulfill the game's goal, given by the O key: depending on the game, score as many points as you can, reach a score, or keep a minimum Impact every turn. Each turn ends with a resolution, which produces an Impact. The Impact is added to your score.
marbles.help.goal.title: Goal of the game
marbles.help.hand.text: You draw {firstDraw, plural, one {# marble} other {# marbles}} on the first turn, then {draw, plural, one {# marble} other {# marbles}} each turn. Your hand holds {hand, plural, one {# marble} other {# marbles}} at most. Each placement is a throw, and you have {throws, plural, one {# throw} other {# throws}} per turn. Before any placement, you may swap two slots, once per turn.
marbles.help.hand.title: Hand, throws and draw
marbles.help.keys.title: Keys
marbles.help.keywords.text: A marble's effects trigger at specific moments: these are its keywords. On a marble, the E key reads its keywords, and Shift+E opens them in a menu. Control+Up and Control+Down browse its card. The F key reads its families, size and rarity; the V key, its description.
marbles.help.keywords.title: Keywords
marbles.help.score.text: Marble effects change two counters: Speed, which starts at 0, and Mass, which starts at 1. At the end of the turn, the Impact is Speed times Mass. For this calculation, a negative Speed counts as 0, and a Mass below 1 counts as 1.
marbles.help.score.title: Score: Speed, Mass and Impact
marbles.help.statuses.text: Some effects give the game a status: a lasting effect that changes a characteristic (your throws, your hand size, the pot capacity), modifies a value (Speed and Mass gains or losses, the Impact) or reacts to what happens. A status lasts this turn, several turns, next turn, the whole game, or a number of charges. Applied again, it strengthens in intensity or duration, or stays as it is if it is unique. The A key says your statuses, Shift+A opens their menu.
marbles.help.statuses.title: Statuses
marbles.help.title: Marbles help
marbles.help.triangle.text: The triangle has three slots: the right base, the left base and the apex, clockwise. During the resolution, each slot plays its phase in that order, the apex last. Then the triangle turns one notch the same way: the right base moves to the left base, the left base to the apex, and the apex to the right base.
marbles.help.triangle.title: The triangle and its rotation
marbles.help.wear.text: A marble on the triangle takes 1 wear at each phase. At its maximum wear, it leaves the triangle: its Final effect triggers, then it reaches the discard pile, where its Drop effect triggers. Polish removes wear, Crack adds some.
marbles.help.wear.title: Wear
marbles.help.zones.text: The bag holds the marbles to draw. The discard pile receives those that leave the triangle, and those that effects send there; when the bag is empty, it is shuffled and becomes the bag. The pot keeps up to {pot} pocketed marbles, whose effects play for the whole game. A marble sent to a full pot is lost.
marbles.help.zones.title: The zones: bag, discard, pot, lost marbles
marbles.history.title: Turn {turn} history
marbles.keyword.apex.description: effect played during the apex phase, when the marble sits at the apex.
marbles.keyword.apex.name: Apex
marbles.keyword.applyStatus.description: gives the game a status, a lasting effect that changes a characteristic, modifies a value or reacts to what happens, for this turn, several turns, next turn, the whole game or a number of charges.
marbles.keyword.applyStatus.name: Apply Status
marbles.keyword.awaken.description: triggers when the marble is drawn.
marbles.keyword.awaken.name: Awaken
marbles.keyword.base.description: effect played during the base phase, when the marble sits at the right or left base. It may differ by side.
marbles.keyword.base.name: Base
marbles.keyword.bounce.description: sends a marble from the triangle back to the hand. If the hand is full, it goes to the discard pile.
marbles.keyword.bounce.name: Bounce
marbles.keyword.crack.description: adds wear to a marble. If it reaches its maximum, the marble is worn out and leaves the triangle at once.
marbles.keyword.crack.name: Crack
marbles.keyword.discard.description: sends a marble to the discard pile.
marbles.keyword.discard.name: Discard
marbles.keyword.draw.description: draws marbles from the bag. If the bag is empty, the discard pile is shuffled to rebuild it.
marbles.keyword.draw.name: Draw
marbles.keyword.drop.description: triggers when the marble arrives in the discard pile, wherever it comes from.
marbles.keyword.drop.name: Drop
marbles.keyword.eject.description: knocks a marble off the triangle: its knockout effect triggers, then it goes to the discard pile.
marbles.keyword.eject.name: Eject
marbles.keyword.final.description: triggers when the marble is worn out and leaves the triangle, before it reaches the discard pile: if its Final pockets it, it goes to the pot without passing through the discard pile.
marbles.keyword.final.name: Final
marbles.keyword.flick.description: triggers when the marble is thrown from the hand, before it reaches the triangle.
marbles.keyword.flick.name: Flick
marbles.keyword.hit.description: triggers when the marble is placed on an occupied spot, after knocking out the marble that was there.
marbles.keyword.hit.name: Hit
marbles.keyword.knockout.description: triggers when the marble is knocked off the triangle.
marbles.keyword.knockout.name: Knockout
marbles.keyword.pocket.description: sends a marble to the pot, wherever it is: on the triangle, in hand or in the discard. If the pot is full, the marble is lost for the rest of the game.
marbles.keyword.pocket.name: Pocket
marbles.keyword.pocketed.description: effects active only while the marble is in the pot: on entering it, at each resolution, or in reaction to what happens during the game.
marbles.keyword.pocketed.name: Pocketed
marbles.keyword.polish.description: removes wear from a marble, so it stays longer on the triangle.
marbles.keyword.polish.name: Polish
marbles.keyword.retrieve.description: takes a marble from the discard pile back to the hand.
marbles.keyword.retrieve.name: Retrieve
marbles.keyword.title: Keywords of {marble}
marbles.keyword.windfall.description: triggers when the bag is rebuilt from the discard pile, if the marble is on the triangle.
marbles.keyword.windfall.name: Windfall

marbles.status.fervor.description: on each flick: Speed +2. 2 turns; unique.
marbles.status.fervor.name: fervor
marbles.status.gravel.description: boulders bring half as much Speed and Mass: their Speed and Mass gains are halved, rounded toward zero.
marbles.status.gravel.name: gravel
marbles.status.inertPot.description: pot marbles do not act: neither when they enter, nor at resolution, nor in reaction.
marbles.status.inertPot.name: inert pot
marbles.status.inspiration.description: the next Draw from an effect draws one more marble. One charge; each new application adds one.

marbles.status.luster.description: Polishes +1 per intensity, for the whole game. Stacks in intensity.

marbles.status.whiplash.description: the next Speed gain is doubled. One charge; each new application adds one.
